title: The gamble changes sign
hook: Two stated cases: explore the sign of a lottery payoff.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the sign of a lottery payoff affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Value, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the sign of a lottery payoff in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: A toy bet wins 4000 with probability 0.8; otherwise it loses 0. Losses count 1 times gains. What is its expected model value?

claims.text: The model weights a loss separately from its probability. A positive cash expectation can coexist with a negative model valuation. This comparison isolates the sign of a lottery payoff.
